units.source_text: 好容易压下去的情绪，这会儿又被强行拨弄起来，真没劲呀。

en.t: The feelings he had finally managed to push down were being forcibly stirred up again now, and it was truly dispiriting.

units.source_text: 可似乎与他的意志无关，血管里有什么东西随意往上涌着。

en.t: But it seemed to have nothing to do with his will; something in his veins was surging upward of its own accord.

units.source_text: 简直像沾在皮肤上的沙子，渗透到了血管里，从内侧剥落着他的情感似的。

en.t: It was almost as if the sand clinging to his skin had seeped into his blood vessels and was stripping his emotions away from the inside.
